verdict.rationale: Conductor is built around delegating coding tasks to AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) that run inside isolated workspaces created by the product, and docs confirm agents can test, build, and run scripts autonomously without step-by-step confirmation. Community feedback corroborates hands-on use of this delegation workflow (e.g., comm-1, comm-7). Missing for 10: a single unified 'native' assistant persona (it's multiple third-party agents orchestrated) and independent benchmarking of delegation reliability.
